next_steps: Integrate Claude API with your Shopify platform using the API key and secret key provided by Claude.
Train the AI model on Baukjen's brand voice and style by uploading a sample of existing product descriptions and providing feedback on the generated content.
Set up a workflow that allows human editors to lightly edit the AI-generated content before publishing, using tools like Zapier or Integromat to automate the process.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Claude API's expertise in nuanced, brand-voice-consistent fashion copy aligns perfectly with Baukjen's need to leverage sustainability credentials in AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation.
Jasper's marketing-focused AI writing tool with fashion/retail content templates can help Baukjen generate high-quality product descriptions that highlight their sustainability credentials.
While ChatGPT API is a general-purpose AI writing tool, its lack of Shopify integration and higher estimated cost (£1000-£2000) make it a less suitable choice for Baukjen's specific needs.
